enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping through the night in Bedroom 1, air conditioner set to a cool comfortable temperature for the heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Remain motionless. Turn to other side. Stretch legs. Sigh. Turn again. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet and taking a cool morning shower to freshen up before work
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Urinate. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step in. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating a quick breakfast with toast and coffee, and filling a water bottle for the hot day ahead
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread, butter, milk. Put bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Open cupboard. Take out mug, coffee. Pour coffee. Add milk. Remove toast. Spread butter. Eat toast. Drink coffee. Wash dishes. Fill water bottle. Turn off light. Leave kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed in light work clothes, checking the phone for messages, and packing a bag with uniform and lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Check messages. Reply to message. Put down phone. Open bag. Put uniform in bag. Put lunch in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Turn off light. Leave bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital in the early heat, travelling by public transport to arrive before the outpatient clinic opens
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Hold handrail. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into uniform. Walk to clinic.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a hospital physiotherapist, running morning rehabilitation sessions, assessing patients and updating treatment notes
enriched_activities.desc: Greet patient. Escort patient to treatment area. Review patient file. Assess patient's range of motion. Palpate muscles. Apply manual therapy. Demonstrate exercise. Assist patient with exercise. Monitor patient's form. Provide verbal cues. Measure progress. Record treatment notes. Update patient chart. Schedule next appointment. Repeat with next patient.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital, eating a packed meal and resting in the staff room away from the heat
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to staff room. Open locker. Take out lunch bag. Sit at table. Open lunch box. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Finish meal. Wipe mouth. Throw away trash. Close lunch box. Put lunch box in bag. Lean back in chair. Close eyes. Rest.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing afternoon physiotherapy work, delivering exercise therapy, manual therapy and patient education sessions
enriched_activities.desc: Greet patient. Escort patient to gym area. Review patient goals. Demonstrate exercise. Assist patient with exercise. Apply manual therapy. Teach patient about posture. Provide education on home exercises. Answer patient questions. Record treatment notes. Update patient chart. Schedule next appointment. Repeat with next patient.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the hospital during the hottest part of the day, staying hydrated on the way back
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Drink water from bottle. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing a simple dinner with the induction cooker and rice cooker, then eating at the kitchen table
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir-fry. Add meat. Stir-fry. Turn on rice cooker. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up the dishes and loading the dishwasher, wiping down the counters and putting food away in the refrigerator
enriched_activities.desc: Clear table. Scrape plates into trash. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counters with cloth. Put leftovers in containers. Open refrigerator. Place containers inside. Close refrigerator. Wipe stove. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool evening shower and changing into light comfortable clothes for the night
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step in. Wash body. Shampoo. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Leave bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing in front of the TV with the air conditioner on, watching a show and doing light stretching for the back and shoulders
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Turn on TV. Turn on air conditioner. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Change channel. Put down remote. Watch TV. Stretch arms overhead. Stretch shoulders. Rotate neck. Lean forward. Stretch back. Sit back. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer under the desk lamp to review patient notes, read physiotherapy articles and plan tomorrow's caseload
enriched_activities.desc: Enter study. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on computer. Open patient notes. Read notes. Take notes. Open web browser. Read physiotherapy article. Close article. Open calendar. Plan tomorrow's caseload. Write schedule. Save file. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp. Leave study.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down for bed, checking the phone briefly, setting the alarm and switching off the main light
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Check messages. Set alarm. Put down phone. Turn off light. Get into bed. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in Bedroom 1 with the air conditioner running to stay cool through the hot night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to other side. Stretch legs. Turn again. Sigh. Sleep.
